Our Story

Grace and Shine Cleaning & Maintenance Services is a family-owned business dedicated to bringing excellence to every home and business we serve. Our name reflects our commitment to treating every client with grace and leaving every space shining.

Our Mission

To provide exceptional cleaning and maintenance services that exceed expectations, creating clean, healthy, and beautiful spaces for our clients.

Our Vision

To be the most trusted and respected cleaning service in Charlotte, known for our integrity, quality, and commitment to customer satisfaction.
